### Bar

#### Parent Components

Bar consumes context provided by these components:

#### Props

- [activeBar](https://recharts.github.io#activeBar)(union of 5 variants)- *optional*- The active bar is shown when a user enters a bar chart and this chart has tooltip. Options: - `false`: all bars are passive, nothing happens on mouse events;
- `true`: active bar is rendered separately but the default props are the same as others: so mouse events do not change its appearance. className and zIndex are different though;
- `object`: the props of active bar;
- `function`: the render function of active bar;
- `ReactElement`: the active bar element.
 - DEFAULT: - `false`- FORMAT: - `<Bar activeBar={{ fill: 'red' }} /> <Bar activeBar={CustomActiveBarFn} />`
- [animationBegin](https://recharts.github.io#animationBegin)number- *optional*- Specifies when the animation should begin, the unit of this option is ms. - DEFAULT: - `0`
- [animationDuration](https://recharts.github.io#animationDuration)number- *optional*- Specifies the duration of animation, the unit of this option is ms. - DEFAULT: - `400`
- [animationEasing](https://recharts.github.io#animationEasing)"ease" | "ease-in" | "ease-in-out" | "ease-out" | "linear" | "spring" | EasingFunction | `cubic-bezier(${number},${number},${number},${number})`- *optional*- The type of easing function. - DEFAULT: - `"ease"`
- [animationInterpolateFn](https://recharts.github.io#animationInterpolateFn)AnimationInterpolateFn<BarRectangleItem, CartesianLayout>- *optional*- Custom animation function for interpolating data items. When provided, this replaces the default animation interpolation.
- [animationMatchBy](https://recharts.github.io#animationMatchBy)"append" | "index" | AnimationMatchBy<BarRectangleItem>- *optional*- Strategy for matching previous items to next items during animation. Determines how Recharts pairs old data points with new data points to create smooth transitions. - `matchAppend`(default): match sequentially by index and treat newly appended items as new
- `matchByIndex`: match by array position with proportional stretching
- `matchByDataKey('someKey')`: match by a data key from the payload
- Custom function `(item, index) => key`: match by the returned key
 - DEFAULT: - `"append"`
- [background](https://recharts.github.io#background)(union of 5 variants)- *optional*- Renders a background for each bar. Options: - `false`: no background;
- `true`: renders default background;
- `object`: the props of background rectangle;
- `ReactElement`: a custom background element;
- `function`: a render function of custom background.
 - DEFAULT: - `false`
- [barSize](https://recharts.github.io#barSize)number | string- *optional*- The width or height of each bar. If the barSize is not specified, the size of bar will be calculated by the barCategoryGap, barGap and the quantity of bar groups.
- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*
- [className](https://recharts.github.io#className)string- *optional*
- [dangerouslySetInnerHTML](https://recharts.github.io#dangerouslySetInnerHTML)Object- *optional*
- [dataKey](https://recharts.github.io#dataKey)TypedDataKey<DataPointType, DataValueType>- *optional*- The data that you provide via the - `data`prop is an array of objects. Each object can have multiple properties, each representing a different data dimension. Use the- `dataKey`prop to specify which property (or dimension) to use for this component.- Typically, you will want to have one dataKey on the X axis, and different dataKey on the Y axis, where they extract different values from the same data objects. - Decides how to extract the value from the data: - `string`: the name of the field in the data object;
- `number`: the index of the field in the data;
- `function`: a function that receives the data object and returns the value.

- [formatter](https://recharts.github.io#formatter)Formatter- *optional*- Formats the value displayed in the tooltip for this Bar. When set, takes precedence over the - `formatter`prop on the Tooltip component.
- [hide](https://recharts.github.io#hide)boolean- *optional*- Hides the whole graphical element when true. - Hiding an element is different from removing it from the chart: Hidden graphical elements are still visible in Legend, and can be included in axis domain calculations, depending on - `includeHidden`props of your XAxis/YAxis.- DEFAULT: - `false`
- [id](https://recharts.github.io#id)string- *optional*- The unique identifier of this component. Used as an HTML attribute - `id`, and also to identify this element internally.- If undefined, Recharts will generate a unique ID automatically.
- [index](https://recharts.github.io#index)bigint | number | string- *optional*
- [isAnimationActive](https://recharts.github.io#isAnimationActive)"auto" | false | true- *optional*- If set false, animation of bar will be disabled. If set "auto", the animation will be disabled in SSR and will respect the user's prefers-reduced-motion system preference for accessibility. - DEFAULT: - `"auto"`
- [label](https://recharts.github.io#label)Function | Props | ReactNode | false | true- *optional*- Renders one label for each bar. Options: - `true`: renders default labels;
- `false`: no labels are rendered;
- `object`: the props of LabelList component;
- `ReactElement`: a custom label element;
- `function`: a render function of custom label.
 - DEFAULT: - `false`- FORMAT: - `<Bar label /> <Bar label={{ position: 'top', fontSize: 20 }} /> <Bar label={CustomizedLabelFn} />`
- [legendType](https://recharts.github.io#legendType)"circle" | "cross" | "diamond" | "line" | "none" | "plainline" | "rect" | "square" | "star" | "triangle" | "wye"- *optional*- The type of icon in legend. If set to 'none', no legend item will be rendered. - DEFAULT: - `"rect"`
- [maxBarSize](https://recharts.github.io#maxBarSize)number- *optional*- The maximum width of bar in a horizontal chart, or maximum height in a vertical chart.
- [minPointSize](https://recharts.github.io#minPointSize)Function | number- *optional*- The minimal height of a bar in a horizontal chart, or the minimal width of a bar in a vertical chart. - By default, 0 values are not shown. To visualize a 0 (or close to zero) point, set the minimal point size to a pixel value like 3. - In stacked bar charts, minPointSize might not be respected for tightly packed values. So we strongly recommend not using this props in stacked BarChart. - You may provide a function to conditionally change this prop based on Bar value. - DEFAULT: - `0`
- [name](https://recharts.github.io#name)number | string- *optional*- The name of data. This option will be used in tooltip and legend to represent a bar. If no value was set to this option, the value of dataKey will be used alternatively.
- [radius](https://recharts.github.io#radius)[number, number, number, number] | number- *optional*- The radius of corners. - If you provide a single number, it applies to all four corners. If you provide an array of four numbers, they apply to top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left corners respectively.
- [shape](https://recharts.github.io#shape)(union of 5 variants)- *optional*- If set a ReactElement, the shape of bar can be customized. If set a function, the function will be called to render customized shape. During animations, the function shape also receives - `animationElapsedTime`,- `isAnimating`, and- `isEntrance`. By default, renders a rectangle.
- [stackId](https://recharts.github.io#stackId)number | string- *optional*- When two Bars have the same axisId and same stackId, then the two Bars are stacked in the chart.
- [tooltipType](https://recharts.github.io#tooltipType)"none"- *optional*
- [unit](https://recharts.github.io#unit)number | string- *optional*- The unit of data. This option will be used in tooltip.
- [xAxisId](https://recharts.github.io#xAxisId)number | string- *optional*- The id of XAxis which is corresponding to the data. Required when there are multiple XAxes. - DEFAULT: - `0`
- [yAxisId](https://recharts.github.io#yAxisId)number | string- *optional*- The id of YAxis which is corresponding to the data. Required when there are multiple YAxes. - DEFAULT: - `0`
- [zIndex](https://recharts.github.io#zIndex)number- *optional*- Z-Index of this component and its children. The higher the value, the more on top it will be rendered. Components with higher zIndex will appear in front of components with lower zIndex. If undefined or 0, the content is rendered in the default layer without portals. - DEFAULT: - `300`
- [onAbort](https://recharts.github.io#onAbort)AdaptChildReactEventHandler<P, T>- *optional*
- [onAbortCapture](https://recharts.github.io#onAbortCapture)AdaptChildReactEventHandler<P, T>- *optional*

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/BarChart/

### BarChart

#### Child Components

BarChart provides context for these components:

#### Props

- [accessibilityLayer](https://recharts.github.io#accessibilityLayer)boolean- *optional*- Turn on accessibility support for keyboard-only and screen reader users. - DEFAULT: - `true`
- [barCategoryGap](https://recharts.github.io#barCategoryGap)number | string- *optional*- The gap between two bar categories, which can be a percent value or a fixed value. - DEFAULT: - `"10%"`
- [barGap](https://recharts.github.io#barGap)number | string- *optional*- The gap between two bars in the same category. - DEFAULT: - `4`
- [barSize](https://recharts.github.io#barSize)number | string- *optional*- The width or height of each bar. If the barSize is not specified, the size of the bar will be calculated by the barCategoryGap, barGap and the quantity of bar groups.
- [baseValue](https://recharts.github.io#baseValue)"dataMax" | "dataMin" | number- *optional*- Configures the starting value used to build the internal baseline for non-ranged, non-stacked areas. - WARNING despite the name - `dataMin`|- `dataMax`this actually reads the domain instead, so it should rather be- `domainMin`|- `domainMax`. This looks like a small detail, but it's actually important because domains are usually extended automatically. For example the default numerical domain starts from 0.- `number`: uses the corresponding axis value as a flat baseline
- `dataMin`: uses the minimum of the value-axis domain
- `dataMax`: uses the maximum of the value-axis domain
 - This uses the same - `BaseValue`resolution as the- `baseValue`prop on- `<Area />`, but acts as a fallback: item-level- `Area.baseValue`takes precedence over the chart-level- `baseValue`.- Ignored for stacked areas and for ranged areas where - `dataKey`already returns- `[min, max]`tuples.- Note that the baseValue does not interact with - `animationInterpolateFn`; baseValue is always animated by linear interpolation. If you want a custom animation then have your- `dataKey`return a tuple of two values instead of a single number which will also render a ranged Area, and that does work with your custom- `animationInterpolateFn`.
- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*
- [className](https://recharts.github.io#className)string- *optional*
- [compact](https://recharts.github.io#compact)boolean- *optional*
- [cursor](https://recharts.github.io#cursor)(union of 45 variants)- *optional*- The CSS cursor style applied to the chart container. Useful for setting the mouse cursor when hovering over the chart (e.g. - `"pointer"`,- `"crosshair"`).
- [data](https://recharts.github.io#data)ReadonlyArray<DataPointType>- *optional*- The source data. Each element should be an object. The properties of each object represent the values of different data dimensions. - Use the - `dataKey`prop to specify which properties to use.- FORMAT: - `data={[{ name: 'a', value: 12 }]} data={[{ label: 'foo', measurements: [5, 12] }]}`
- [dataKey](https://recharts.github.io#dataKey)Function | number | string- *optional*
- [desc](https://recharts.github.io#desc)string- *optional*
- [height](https://recharts.github.io#height)`${number}%` | number- *optional*- The height of chart container. Can be a number or a percent string like "100%".
- [id](https://recharts.github.io#id)string- *optional*
- [layout](https://recharts.github.io#layout)"horizontal" | "vertical"- *optional*- The layout of chart defines the orientation of axes, graphical items, and tooltip. - DEFAULT: - `"horizontal"`
- [margin](https://recharts.github.io#margin)Partial<Margin>- *optional*- Empty space around the container. - DEFAULT: - `{"top":5,"right":5,"bottom":5,"left":5}`
- [maxBarSize](https://recharts.github.io#maxBarSize)number- *optional*- The maximum width of all the bars in a horizontal BarChart, or maximum height in a vertical BarChart.
- [ref](https://recharts.github.io#ref)Function | React.RefObject<SVGSVGElement> | null- *optional*
- [responsive](https://recharts.github.io#responsive)boolean- *optional*- If true, then it will listen to container size changes and adapt the SVG chart accordingly. If false, then it renders the chart at the specified width and height and will stay that way even if the container size changes. - This is similar to ResponsiveContainer but without the need for an extra wrapper component. The - `responsive`prop also uses standard CSS sizing rules, instead of custom resolution logic (like ResponsiveContainer does).- DEFAULT: - `false`
- [reverseStackOrder](https://recharts.github.io#reverseStackOrder)boolean- *optional*- If - `false`, stacked items will be rendered left to right. If- `true`, stacked items will be rendered right to left.- Render direction affects SVG layering, not x position. - DEFAULT: - `false`
- [role](https://recharts.github.io#role)string- *optional*- The ARIA role for the chart, which provides semantic information for screen reader users.
- [stackOffset](https://recharts.github.io#stackOffset)"expand" | "none" | "positive" | "sign" | "silhouette" | "wiggle"- *optional*- The type of offset function used to generate the lower and upper values in the series array. The types are built-in offsets in d3-shape. Only applicable for stacked Area or Bar charts. Has no effect when the stackId prop is not set on Area or Bar components. - DEFAULT: - `"none"`
- [style](https://recharts.github.io#style)React.CSSProperties- *optional*
- [syncId](https://recharts.github.io#syncId)number | string- *optional*- Charts with the same syncId will synchronize Tooltip and Brush events.
- [syncMethod](https://recharts.github.io#syncMethod)"index" | "value" | Function- *optional*- Customize how the charts will synchronize tooltips and brushes. - `index`: synchronize using the data index in the data array. Index expects that all data has the same length.- `value`: synchronize using the data value on categorical axis (categorical: XAxis in horizontal layout, YAxis in vertical layout). function: a custom sync method which receives tick and data as argument and returns an index.- DEFAULT: - `"index"`
- [tabIndex](https://recharts.github.io#tabIndex)number- *optional*- If and where the chart should appear in the tab order
- [throttleDelay](https://recharts.github.io#throttleDelay)"raf" | number- *optional*- Decides the time interval to throttle events. Only events defined in - `throttledEvents`prop are throttled. All other events are executed immediately/synchronously.- Options: - `number`: the time interval in milliseconds
- `'raf'`: use requestAnimationFrame to schedule updates.
 - DEFAULT: - `"raf"`
- [throttledEvents](https://recharts.github.io#throttledEvents)"all" | Array<keyof GlobalEventHandlersEventMap>- *optional*- Defines which events should be throttled. Events not in this list will not be throttled. - Use the special value - `'all'`to throttle all events. Empty array means no events are throttled.- Use the prop - `throttleDelay`to define the throttling interval.- If an event is on this list, then you lose the opportunity to access the event synchronously. Which means that if you want to call - `e.preventDefault()`or- `e.stopPropagation()`inside the event handler, then that event handler must not be in this list.- DEFAULT: - `["mousemove","touchmove","pointermove","scroll","wheel"]`
- [title](https://recharts.github.io#title)string- *optional*
- [width](https://recharts.github.io#width)`${number}%` | number- *optional*- The width of chart container. Can be a number or a percent string like "100%".
- [onClick](https://recharts.github.io#onClick)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of click in this chart.
- [onContextMenu](https://recharts.github.io#onContextMenu)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of contextmenu in this chart.
- [onDoubleClick](https://recharts.github.io#onDoubleClick)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of dblclick in this chart.
- [onMouseDown](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseDown)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mousedown in this chart.
- [onMouseEnter](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseEnter)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mouseenter in this chart.
- [onMouseLeave](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseLeave)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mouseleave in this chart.
- [onMouseMove](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseMove)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mousemove in this chart.
- [onMouseUp](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseUp)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mouseup in this chart.
- [onTouchEnd](https://recharts.github.io#onTouchEnd)CategoricalChartFunc<React.TouchEvent<SVGGraphicsElement>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of touchend in this chart.
- [onTouchMove](https://recharts.github.io#onTouchMove)CategoricalChartFunc<React.TouchEvent<SVGGraphicsElement>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of touchmove in this chart.
- [onTouchStart](https://recharts.github.io#onTouchStart)CategoricalChartFunc<React.TouchEvent<SVGGraphicsElement>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of touchstart in this chart.

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/BarStack/

### BarStack

Available since Recharts 3.6

#### Props

- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*
- [radius](https://recharts.github.io#radius)[number, number, number, number] | number- *optional*- Radius applies only once to all bars inside of this stack group, as if they were one huge bar. Meaning that if you have three bars stacked together, and you set radius to 10, only the outer corners of the entire stack will be rounded: the middle bars will have square corners. - Unless! The edge bars are smaller than the radius value, in which case the bars at the edge get a lot of radius and the middle one gets a little bit of radius. - You may want to combine this with setting individual Bar components' radius to their own values for best effect. - `Bar.radius`prop will round corners of individual bars, while- `BarStack.radius`will round corners of the entire stack.- If you provide a single number, it applies to all four corners. If you provide an array of four numbers, they apply to top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left corners respectively. - DEFAULT: - `0`
- [stackId](https://recharts.github.io#stackId)number | string- *optional*- When two Bars have the same axisId and same stackId, then the two Bars are stacked in the chart. This prop sets the stack ID for all Bar components inside this BarStack component. If undefined, a unique id will be generated automatically. - When both BarStack and individual Bar components have stackId defined, the BarStack's stackId wins, and the individual Bar's stackId is ignored.

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/Brush/

### Brush

Renders a scrollbar that allows the user to zoom and pan in the chart along its XAxis. It also allows you to render a small overview of the chart inside the brush that is always visible and shows the full data set so that the user can see where they are zoomed in. If a chart is synchronized with other charts using the `syncId` prop on the chart, the brush will also synchronize the zooming and panning between all synchronized charts.

#### Parent Components

Brush consumes context provided by these components:

#### Props

- [alwaysShowText](https://recharts.github.io#alwaysShowText)boolean- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `false`
- [ariaLabel](https://recharts.github.io#ariaLabel)string- *optional*
- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*
- [className](https://recharts.github.io#className)string- *optional*
- [dataKey](https://recharts.github.io#dataKey)TypedDataKey<DataPointType, DataValueType>- *optional*- The data that you provide via the - `data`prop is an array of objects. Each object can have multiple properties, each representing a different data dimension. Use the- `dataKey`prop to specify which property (or dimension) to use for this component.- Typically, you will want to have one dataKey on the X axis, and different dataKey on the Y axis, where they extract different values from the same data objects. - Decides how to extract the value from the data: - `string`: the name of the field in the data object;
- `number`: the index of the field in the data;
- `function`: a function that receives the data object and returns the value.

- [dy](https://recharts.github.io#dy)number | string- *optional*
- [endIndex](https://recharts.github.io#endIndex)number- *optional*- The default end index of brush. If the option is not set, the end index will be calculated by the length of data.
- [gap](https://recharts.github.io#gap)number- *optional*- Number of data points to skip between chart refreshes. - DEFAULT: - `1`
- [height](https://recharts.github.io#height)number | string- *optional*- Height of the brush in pixels. - DEFAULT: - `40`
- [leaveTimeOut](https://recharts.github.io#leaveTimeOut)number- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `1000`
- [padding](https://recharts.github.io#padding)Padding- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `{"top":1,"right":1,"bottom":1,"left":1}`
- [startIndex](https://recharts.github.io#startIndex)number- *optional*- The default start index of brush. If the option is not set, the start index will be 0.
- [tickFormatter](https://recharts.github.io#tickFormatter)BrushTickFormatter- *optional*- The formatter function of ticks.
- [traveller](https://recharts.github.io#traveller)Function | ReactNode- *optional*
- [travellerWidth](https://recharts.github.io#travellerWidth)number- *optional*- The width of each traveller. - DEFAULT: - `5`
- [width](https://recharts.github.io#width)number | string- *optional*- Width of the brush in pixels. If undefined, defaults to the chart width.
- [x](https://recharts.github.io#x)number | string- *optional*- The x-coordinate of brush. If left undefined, it will be computed from the chart's offset and margins.
- [y](https://recharts.github.io#y)number | string- *optional*- The y-coordinate of brush. If left undefined, it will be computed from the chart's offset and margins.
- [onChange](https://recharts.github.io#onChange)OnBrushUpdate- *optional*- The handler of changing the active scope of brush.
- [onDragEnd](https://recharts.github.io#onDragEnd)OnBrushUpdate- *optional*

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/CartesianGrid/

### CartesianGrid

Renders background grid with lines and fill colors in a Cartesian chart.

#### Parent Components

CartesianGrid consumes context provided by these components:

#### Props

- [fill](https://recharts.github.io#fill)string- *optional*- The background color used to fill the space between grid lines - DEFAULT: - `"none"`- FORMAT: - `<CartesianGrid fill="red" /> <CartesianGrid fill="#ccc" />`
- [fillOpacity](https://recharts.github.io#fillOpacity)number | string- *optional*- The opacity of the background used to fill the space between grid lines - FORMAT: - `<CartesianGrid fill="red" fillOpacity={0.6} />`
- [height](https://recharts.github.io#height)number | string- *optional*- The height of grid. If undefined, covers the full height of the chart plot area.
- [horizontal](https://recharts.github.io#horizontal)(union of 5 variants)- *optional*- If set false, no horizontal grid lines will be drawn. - DEFAULT: - `true`
- [horizontalCoordinatesGenerator](https://recharts.github.io#horizontalCoordinatesGenerator)HorizontalCoordinatesGenerator- *optional*- A function that generates the y-coordinates of all horizontal lines.
- [horizontalFill](https://recharts.github.io#horizontalFill)Array<string>- *optional*- Defines background color of stripes. - The values from this array will be passed in as the - `fill`property in a- `rect`SVG element. For possible values see:- [https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/fill#rect](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/fill#rect)- In case there are more stripes than colors, the colors will start from beginning. So for example: horizontalFill['yellow', 'black'] produces a pattern of yellow|black|yellow|black - If this is undefined, or an empty array, then there is no background fill. Note: Grid lines will be rendered above these background stripes. - DEFAULT: - `[]`
- [horizontalPoints](https://recharts.github.io#horizontalPoints)Array<number>- *optional*- Array of coordinates in pixels where to draw horizontal grid lines. Has priority over syncWithTicks and horizontalValues. - DEFAULT: - `[]`
- [horizontalValues](https://recharts.github.io#horizontalValues)Array<number> | Array<string>- *optional*- Array of values, where horizontal lines will be drawn. Numbers or strings, in dependence on axis type. Has priority over syncWithTicks but not over horizontalPoints.
- [strokeDasharray](https://recharts.github.io#strokeDasharray)number | string- *optional*- The pattern of dashes and gaps used to paint the lines of the grid - FORMAT: - `<CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" /> <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray={[5, 5, 1, 5]} /> <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="5 5 1 5" />`
- [syncWithTicks](https://recharts.github.io#syncWithTicks)boolean- *optional*- If true, only the lines that correspond to the axes ticks values will be drawn. If false, extra lines could be added for each axis (at min and max coordinates), if there will not such ticks. horizontalPoints, verticalPoints, horizontalValues, verticalValues have priority over syncWithTicks. - DEFAULT: - `false`
- [vertical](https://recharts.github.io#vertical)(union of 5 variants)- *optional*- If set false, no vertical grid lines will be drawn. - DEFAULT: - `true`
- [verticalCoordinatesGenerator](https://recharts.github.io#verticalCoordinatesGenerator)VerticalCoordinatesGenerator- *optional*- A function that generates the x-coordinates of all vertical lines.
- [verticalFill](https://recharts.github.io#verticalFill)Array<string>- *optional*- Defines background color of stripes. - The values from this array will be passed in as the - `fill`property in a- `rect`SVG element. For possible values see:- [https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/fill#rect](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/fill#rect)- In case there are more stripes than colors, the colors will start from beginning. So for example: verticalFill['yellow', 'black'] produces a pattern of yellow|black|yellow|black - If this is undefined, or an empty array, then there is no background fill. Note: Grid lines will be rendered above these background stripes. - DEFAULT: - `[]`
- [verticalPoints](https://recharts.github.io#verticalPoints)Array<number>- *optional*- Array of coordinates in pixels where to draw vertical grid lines. Has priority over syncWithTicks and verticalValues. - DEFAULT: - `[]`
- [verticalValues](https://recharts.github.io#verticalValues)Array<number> | Array<string>- *optional*- Array of values, where vertical lines will be drawn. Numbers or strings, in dependence on axis type. Has priority over syncWithTicks but not over verticalPoints.
- [width](https://recharts.github.io#width)number | string- *optional*- The width of grid. If undefined, covers the full width of the chart plot area.
- [x](https://recharts.github.io#x)number | string- *optional*- The x-coordinate of grid. If left undefined, it will be computed from the chart's offset and margins.
- [xAxisId](https://recharts.github.io#xAxisId)number | string- *optional*- The id of XAxis which is corresponding to the data. Required when there are multiple XAxes. - DEFAULT: - `0`
- [y](https://recharts.github.io#y)number | string- *optional*- The y-coordinate of grid. If left undefined, it will be computed from the chart's offset and margins.
- [yAxisId](https://recharts.github.io#yAxisId)number | string- *optional*- The id of YAxis which is corresponding to the data. Required when there are multiple YAxes. - DEFAULT: - `0`
- [zIndex](https://recharts.github.io#zIndex)number- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `-100`

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/Cell/

### Cell

Cell component used to define colors and styles of chart elements. This component is now deprecated and will be removed in Recharts 4.0. Please use the `shape` prop or `content` prop on the respective chart components to customize the rendering of chart elements instead of using `Cell`.

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/ComposedChart/

### ComposedChart

#### Parent Components

ComposedChart consumes context provided by these components:

#### Child Components

ComposedChart provides context for these components:

#### Props

- [accessibilityLayer](https://recharts.github.io#accessibilityLayer)boolean- *optional*- Turn on accessibility support for keyboard-only and screen reader users. - DEFAULT: - `true`
- [barCategoryGap](https://recharts.github.io#barCategoryGap)number | string- *optional*- The gap between two bar categories, which can be a percent value or a fixed value. - DEFAULT: - `"10%"`
- [barGap](https://recharts.github.io#barGap)number | string- *optional*- The gap between two bars in the same category. - DEFAULT: - `4`
- [barSize](https://recharts.github.io#barSize)number | string- *optional*- The width or height of each bar. If the barSize is not specified, the size of the bar will be calculated by the barCategoryGap, barGap and the quantity of bar groups.
- [baseValue](https://recharts.github.io#baseValue)"dataMax" | "dataMin" | number- *optional*- Configures the starting value used to build the internal baseline for non-ranged, non-stacked areas. - WARNING despite the name - `dataMin`|- `dataMax`this actually reads the domain instead, so it should rather be- `domainMin`|- `domainMax`. This looks like a small detail, but it's actually important because domains are usually extended automatically. For example the default numerical domain starts from 0.- `number`: uses the corresponding axis value as a flat baseline
- `dataMin`: uses the minimum of the value-axis domain
- `dataMax`: uses the maximum of the value-axis domain
 - This uses the same - `BaseValue`resolution as the- `baseValue`prop on- `<Area />`, but acts as a fallback: item-level- `Area.baseValue`takes precedence over the chart-level- `baseValue`.- Ignored for stacked areas and for ranged areas where - `dataKey`already returns- `[min, max]`tuples.- Note that the baseValue does not interact with - `animationInterpolateFn`; baseValue is always animated by linear interpolation. If you want a custom animation then have your- `dataKey`return a tuple of two values instead of a single number which will also render a ranged Area, and that does work with your custom- `animationInterpolateFn`.
- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*
- [className](https://recharts.github.io#className)string- *optional*
- [compact](https://recharts.github.io#compact)boolean- *optional*
- [cursor](https://recharts.github.io#cursor)(union of 45 variants)- *optional*- The CSS cursor style applied to the chart container. Useful for setting the mouse cursor when hovering over the chart (e.g. - `"pointer"`,- `"crosshair"`).
- [data](https://recharts.github.io#data)ReadonlyArray<DataPointType>- *optional*- The source data. Each element should be an object. The properties of each object represent the values of different data dimensions. - Use the - `dataKey`prop to specify which properties to use.- FORMAT: - `data={[{ name: 'a', value: 12 }]} data={[{ label: 'foo', measurements: [5, 12] }]}`
- [dataKey](https://recharts.github.io#dataKey)Function | number | string- *optional*
- [desc](https://recharts.github.io#desc)string- *optional*
- [height](https://recharts.github.io#height)`${number}%` | number- *optional*- The height of chart container. Can be a number or a percent string like "100%".
- [id](https://recharts.github.io#id)string- *optional*
- [layout](https://recharts.github.io#layout)"horizontal" | "vertical"- *optional*- The layout of chart defines the orientation of axes, graphical items, and tooltip. - DEFAULT: - `"horizontal"`
- [margin](https://recharts.github.io#margin)Partial<Margin>- *optional*- Empty space around the container. - DEFAULT: - `{"top":5,"right":5,"bottom":5,"left":5}`
- [maxBarSize](https://recharts.github.io#maxBarSize)number- *optional*- The maximum width of all the bars in a horizontal BarChart, or maximum height in a vertical BarChart.
- [ref](https://recharts.github.io#ref)Function | React.RefObject<SVGSVGElement> | null- *optional*
- [responsive](https://recharts.github.io#responsive)boolean- *optional*- If true, then it will listen to container size changes and adapt the SVG chart accordingly. If false, then it renders the chart at the specified width and height and will stay that way even if the container size changes. - This is similar to ResponsiveContainer but without the need for an extra wrapper component. The - `responsive`prop also uses standard CSS sizing rules, instead of custom resolution logic (like ResponsiveContainer does).- DEFAULT: - `false`
- [reverseStackOrder](https://recharts.github.io#reverseStackOrder)boolean- *optional*- If - `false`, stacked items will be rendered left to right. If- `true`, stacked items will be rendered right to left.- Render direction affects SVG layering, not x position. - DEFAULT: - `false`
- [role](https://recharts.github.io#role)string- *optional*- The ARIA role for the chart, which provides semantic information for screen reader users.
- [stackOffset](https://recharts.github.io#stackOffset)"expand" | "none" | "positive" | "sign" | "silhouette" | "wiggle"- *optional*- The type of offset function used to generate the lower and upper values in the series array. The types are built-in offsets in d3-shape. Only applicable for stacked Area or Bar charts. Has no effect when the stackId prop is not set on Area or Bar components. - DEFAULT: - `"none"`
- [style](https://recharts.github.io#style)React.CSSProperties- *optional*
- [syncId](https://recharts.github.io#syncId)number | string- *optional*- Charts with the same syncId will synchronize Tooltip and Brush events.
- [syncMethod](https://recharts.github.io#syncMethod)"index" | "value" | Function- *optional*- Customize how the charts will synchronize tooltips and brushes. - `index`: synchronize using the data index in the data array. Index expects that all data has the same length.- `value`: synchronize using the data value on categorical axis (categorical: XAxis in horizontal layout, YAxis in vertical layout). function: a custom sync method which receives tick and data as argument and returns an index.- DEFAULT: - `"index"`
- [tabIndex](https://recharts.github.io#tabIndex)number- *optional*- If and where the chart should appear in the tab order
- [throttleDelay](https://recharts.github.io#throttleDelay)"raf" | number- *optional*- Decides the time interval to throttle events. Only events defined in - `throttledEvents`prop are throttled. All other events are executed immediately/synchronously.- Options: - `number`: the time interval in milliseconds
- `'raf'`: use requestAnimationFrame to schedule updates.
 - DEFAULT: - `"raf"`
- [throttledEvents](https://recharts.github.io#throttledEvents)"all" | Array<keyof GlobalEventHandlersEventMap>- *optional*- Defines which events should be throttled. Events not in this list will not be throttled. - Use the special value - `'all'`to throttle all events. Empty array means no events are throttled.- Use the prop - `throttleDelay`to define the throttling interval.- If an event is on this list, then you lose the opportunity to access the event synchronously. Which means that if you want to call - `e.preventDefault()`or- `e.stopPropagation()`inside the event handler, then that event handler must not be in this list.- DEFAULT: - `["mousemove","touchmove","pointermove","scroll","wheel"]`
- [title](https://recharts.github.io#title)string- *optional*
- [width](https://recharts.github.io#width)`${number}%` | number- *optional*- The width of chart container. Can be a number or a percent string like "100%".
- [onClick](https://recharts.github.io#onClick)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of click in this chart.
- [onContextMenu](https://recharts.github.io#onContextMenu)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of contextmenu in this chart.
- [onDoubleClick](https://recharts.github.io#onDoubleClick)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of dblclick in this chart.
- [onMouseDown](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseDown)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mousedown in this chart.
- [onMouseEnter](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseEnter)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mouseenter in this chart.
- [onMouseLeave](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseLeave)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mouseleave in this chart.
- [onMouseMove](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseMove)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mousemove in this chart.
- [onMouseUp](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseUp)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mouseup in this chart.
- [onTouchEnd](https://recharts.github.io#onTouchEnd)CategoricalChartFunc<React.TouchEvent<SVGGraphicsElement>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of touchend in this chart.

#### Props

- [baseLine](https://recharts.github.io#baseLine)Array<NullableCoordinate> | number- *optional*- Baseline of the area: - number: uses the corresponding axis value as a flat baseline;
- an array of coordinates: describes a custom baseline path.

- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*
- [className](https://recharts.github.io#className)string- *optional*
- [connectNulls](https://recharts.github.io#connectNulls)boolean- *optional*- Whether to connect the curve across null points. - DEFAULT: - `false`
- [dangerouslySetInnerHTML](https://recharts.github.io#dangerouslySetInnerHTML)Object- *optional*
- [layout](https://recharts.github.io#layout)"centric" | "horizontal" | "radial" | "vertical"- *optional*- This option affects the interpolation algorithm when the - `type`prop is set to 'monotone'. It also specifies the type of baseline when the curve is closed.
- [path](https://recharts.github.io#path)string- *optional*
- [pathRef](https://recharts.github.io#pathRef)Function | React.RefObject<SVGPathElement> | null- *optional*
- [points](https://recharts.github.io#points)Array<NullableCoordinate>- *optional*- The coordinates of all the points in the curve, like an array of objects with x and y coordinates.
- [strokeDasharray](https://recharts.github.io#strokeDasharray)number | string- *optional*- The pattern of dashes and gaps used to paint the line. - FORMAT: - `strokeDasharray="5 5" strokeDasharray={10}`
- [type](https://recharts.github.io#type)"basis" | "basisClosed" | "basisOpen" | "bump" | "bumpX" | "bumpY" | "linear" | "linearClosed" | "monotone" | "monotoneX" | "monotoneY" | "natural" | "step" | "stepAfter" | "stepBefore" | CurveFactory- *optional*- The interpolation type of curve. Allows custom interpolation function. - DEFAULT: - `"linear"`
- [onAbort](https://recharts.github.io#onAbort)ReactEventHandler<P, T>- *optional*

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/Customized/

### Customized

Customized component used to be necessary to render custom elements in Recharts 2.x. Starting from Recharts 3.x, all charts are able to render arbitrary elements anywhere, and Customized is no longer needed.

#### Props

- [component](https://recharts.github.io#component)C- *@deprecated*- Render your components directly, without Customized wrapper. Will be removed in 4.0 - FORMAT: - `Before: `<Customized component={<MyCustomComponent />} />` After: `<MyCustomComponent />``

---

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/DefaultLegendContent/

### DefaultLegendContent

This component is by default rendered inside the  You can use this component to customize the content of the legend, or you can provide your own completely independent content.[Legend](https://recharts.github.io/en-US/api/Legend) component. You would not use it directly.

#### Props

- [align](https://recharts.github.io#align)"center" | "left" | "right"- *optional*- Horizontal alignment of the whole Legend container: - `left`: shows the Legend to the left of the chart, and chart width reduces automatically to make space for it.
- `right`shows the Legend to the right of the chart, and chart width reduces automatically.
- `center`shows the Legend in the middle of chart, and chart width remains unchanged.
 - The exact behavior changes depending on 'verticalAlign' prop. - DEFAULT: - `"center"`
- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*
- [dangerouslySetInnerHTML](https://recharts.github.io#dangerouslySetInnerHTML)Object- *optional*
- [formatter](https://recharts.github.io#formatter)Formatter- *optional*- Function to customize how content is serialized before rendering. - This should return HTML elements, or strings. - FORMAT: - `(value, entry, index) => <span style={{ color: 'red' }}>{value}</span> https://codesandbox.io/s/legend-formatter-rmzp9`
- [iconSize](https://recharts.github.io#iconSize)number- *optional*- The size of icon in each legend item. - DEFAULT: - `14`
- [iconType](https://recharts.github.io#iconType)"circle" | "cross" | "diamond" | "line" | "none" | "plainline" | "rect" | "square" | "star" | "triangle" | "wye"- *optional*- The type of icon in each legend item.
- [inactiveColor](https://recharts.github.io#inactiveColor)string- *optional*- The color of the icon when the item is inactive. - DEFAULT: - `"#ccc"`
- [labelStyle](https://recharts.github.io#labelStyle)React.CSSProperties- *optional*- The style of each text label which is a span element. - DEFAULT: - `{}`
- [layout](https://recharts.github.io#layout)"horizontal" | "vertical"- *optional*- The layout of legend items inside the legend container. - DEFAULT: - `"horizontal"`
- [payload](https://recharts.github.io#payload)Array<LegendPayload>- *optional*- DefaultLegendContent.payload is omitted from Legend props. A custom payload can be passed here if desired, or it can be passed from the Legend "content" callback.
- [verticalAlign](https://recharts.github.io#verticalAlign)"bottom" | "middle" | "top"- *optional*- Vertical alignment of the whole Legend container: - `bottom`: shows the Legend below chart, and chart height reduces automatically to make space for it.
- `top`: shows the Legend above chart, and chart height reduces automatically.
- `middle`: shows the Legend in the middle of chart, covering other content, and chart height remains unchanged. The exact behavior changes depending on- `align`prop.
 - DEFAULT: - `"middle"`

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/DefaultTooltipContent/

### DefaultTooltipContent

This component is by default rendered inside the  You can use this component to customize the content of the tooltip, or you can provide your own completely independent content.[Tooltip](https://recharts.github.io/en-US/api/Tooltip) component. You would not use it directly.

#### Props

- [accessibilityLayer](https://recharts.github.io#accessibilityLayer)boolean- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `false`
- [contentStyle](https://recharts.github.io#contentStyle)React.CSSProperties- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `{"margin":0,"padding":10,"backgroundColor":"#fff","border":"1px solid #ccc","whiteSpace":"nowrap"}`
- [formatter](https://recharts.github.io#formatter)Formatter<TValue, TName>- *optional*
- [itemSorter](https://recharts.github.io#itemSorter)"dataKey" | "name" | "value" | Function- *optional*
- [itemStyle](https://recharts.github.io#itemStyle)React.CSSProperties- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `{"display":"block","paddingTop":4,"paddingBottom":4,"color":"#000"}`
- [label](https://recharts.github.io#label)ReactNode- *optional*
- [labelClassName](https://recharts.github.io#labelClassName)string- *optional*
- [labelFormatter](https://recharts.github.io#labelFormatter)Function- *optional*
- [labelStyle](https://recharts.github.io#labelStyle)React.CSSProperties- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `{}`
- [payload](https://recharts.github.io#payload)Array<Payload<TValue, TName>>- *optional*
- [separator](https://recharts.github.io#separator)string- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `" : "`
- [wrapperClassName](https://recharts.github.io#wrapperClassName)string- *optional*

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/Dot/

### Dot

Renders a dot in the chart. This component accepts X and Y coordinates in pixels. If you need to position the rectangle based on your chart's data, consider using the [ReferenceDot](https://recharts.github.io/en-US/api/ReferenceDot) component instead.

#### Props

- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*
- [className](https://recharts.github.io#className)string- *optional*
- [clipDot](https://recharts.github.io#clipDot)boolean- *optional*
- [cx](https://recharts.github.io#cx)number | string- *optional*- The x-coordinate of center in pixels.
- [cy](https://recharts.github.io#cy)number | string- *optional*- The y-coordinate of center in pixels.
- [dangerouslySetInnerHTML](https://recharts.github.io#dangerouslySetInnerHTML)Object- *optional*
- [r](https://recharts.github.io#r)number | string- *optional*- The radius of dot.
- [onAbort](https://recharts.github.io#onAbort)ReactEventHandler<P, T>- *optional*

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/ErrorBar/

### ErrorBar

ErrorBar renders whiskers to represent error margins on a chart. It must be a child of a graphical element. ErrorBar expects data in one of the following forms: The values provided are relative to the main data value. For example, if the main data value is 10 and the error value is 2, the error bar will extend from 8 to 12 for symmetric error bars. In other words, what ErrorBar will render is: In stacked or ranged Bar charts, ErrorBar will use the higher data value as the reference point for calculating the error bar positions.

#### Props

- [dataKey](https://recharts.github.io#dataKey)DataKey<DataPointType, DataValueType>- Decides how to extract the value of this ErrorBar from the data: - `string`: the name of the field in the data object;
- `number`: the index of the field in the data;
- `function`: a function that receives the data object and returns the value of this ErrorBar.
 - The error values can be a single value for symmetric error bars; or an array of a lower and upper error value for asymmetric error bars.
- [animationBegin](https://recharts.github.io#animationBegin)number- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `0`
- [animationDuration](https://recharts.github.io#animationDuration)number- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `400`
- [animationEasing](https://recharts.github.io#animationEasing)"ease" | "ease-in" | "ease-in-out" | "ease-out" | "linear" | "spring" | EasingFunction | `cubic-bezier(${number},${number},${number},${number})`- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `"ease-in-out"`
- [direction](https://recharts.github.io#direction)number | string- *optional*- Direction of the error bar. Usually determined by chart layout, except in Scatter chart. In Scatter chart, "x" means horizontal error bars, "y" means vertical error bars.
- [isAnimationActive](https://recharts.github.io#isAnimationActive)boolean- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `true`
- [stroke](https://recharts.github.io#stroke)string- *optional*- The stroke color. If "none", no line will be drawn. - DEFAULT: - `"black"`
- [strokeWidth](https://recharts.github.io#strokeWidth)number | string- *optional*- The width of the stroke - DEFAULT: - `1.5`
- [width](https://recharts.github.io#width)number | string- *optional*- Width of the error bar ends (the serifs) in pixels. This is not the total width of the error bar, but just the width of the little lines at the ends. - The total width of the error bar is determined by the data value plus/minus the error value. - DEFAULT: - `5`
- [zIndex](https://recharts.github.io#zIndex)number- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `400`

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/Funnel/

### Funnel

#### Props

- [dataKey](https://recharts.github.io#dataKey)TypedDataKey<DataPointType, DataValueType>- The data that you provide via the - `data`prop is an array of objects. Each object can have multiple properties, each representing a different data dimension. Use the- `dataKey`prop to specify which property (or dimension) to use for this component.- Typically, you will want to have one dataKey on the X axis, and different dataKey on the Y axis, where they extract different values from the same data objects. - Decides how to extract the value from the data: - `string`: the name of the field in the data object;
- `number`: the index of the field in the data;
- `function`: a function that receives the data object and returns the value.

- [activeShape](https://recharts.github.io#activeShape)(union of 5 variants)- *optional*- This component is rendered when this graphical item is activated (could be by mouse hover, touch, keyboard, programmatically).
- [animationBegin](https://recharts.github.io#animationBegin)number- *optional*- Specifies when the animation should begin, the unit of this option is ms. - DEFAULT: - `400`
- [animationDuration](https://recharts.github.io#animationDuration)number- *optional*- Specifies the duration of animation, the unit of this option is ms. - DEFAULT: - `1500`
- [animationEasing](https://recharts.github.io#animationEasing)"ease" | "ease-in" | "ease-in-out" | "ease-out" | "linear" | "spring" | EasingFunction | `cubic-bezier(${number},${number},${number},${number})`- *optional*- The type of easing function. - DEFAULT: - `"ease"`
- [animationInterpolateFn](https://recharts.github.io#animationInterpolateFn)AnimationInterpolateFn<FunnelTrapezoidItem, CartesianLayout>- *optional*- Custom animation function for interpolating data items. When provided, this replaces the default animation interpolation.
- [animationMatchBy](https://recharts.github.io#animationMatchBy)"append" | "index" | AnimationMatchBy<FunnelTrapezoidItem>- *optional*- Strategy for matching previous items to next items during animation. Determines how Recharts pairs old data points with new data points to create smooth transitions. - `matchAppend`(default): match sequentially by index and treat newly appended items as new
- `matchByIndex`: match by array position with proportional stretching
- `matchByDataKey('someKey')`: match by a data key from the payload
- Custom function `(item, index) => key`: match by the returned key
 - DEFAULT: - `"append"`
- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*
- [className](https://recharts.github.io#className)string- *optional*
- [dangerouslySetInnerHTML](https://recharts.github.io#dangerouslySetInnerHTML)Object- *optional*
- [data](https://recharts.github.io#data)ReadonlyArray<DataPointType>- *optional*- The source data. Each element should be an object. The properties of each object represent the values of different data dimensions. - Use the - `dataKey`prop to specify which properties to use.- FORMAT: - `data={[{ name: 'a', value: 12 }]} data={[{ label: 'foo', measurements: [5, 12] }]}`
- [formatter](https://recharts.github.io#formatter)Formatter- *optional*- Formats the value displayed in the tooltip for this Funnel. When set, takes precedence over the - `formatter`prop on the Tooltip component.
- [hide](https://recharts.github.io#hide)boolean- *optional*- Hides the whole graphical element when true. - Hiding an element is different from removing it from the chart: Hidden graphical elements are still visible in Legend, and can be included in axis domain calculations, depending on - `includeHidden`props of your XAxis/YAxis.- DEFAULT: - `false`
- [id](https://recharts.github.io#id)string- *optional*- Unique identifier of this component. Used as an HTML attribute - `id`, and also to identify this element internally.- If undefined, Recharts will generate a unique ID automatically.
- [isAnimationActive](https://recharts.github.io#isAnimationActive)"auto" | false | true- *optional*- If set false, animation of funnel will be disabled. If set "auto", the animation will be disabled in SSR and will respect the user's prefers-reduced-motion system preference for accessibility. - DEFAULT: - `"auto"`
- [label](https://recharts.github.io#label)Function | Props | ReactNode | false | true- *optional*
- [lastShapeType](https://recharts.github.io#lastShapeType)"rectangle" | "triangle"- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `"triangle"`
- [legendType](https://recharts.github.io#legendType)"circle" | "cross" | "diamond" | "line" | "none" | "plainline" | "rect" | "square" | "star" | "triangle" | "wye"- *optional*- The type of icon in legend. If set to 'none', no legend item will be rendered. - DEFAULT: - `"rect"`
- [nameKey](https://recharts.github.io#nameKey)TypedDataKey<DataPointType, DataValueType>- *optional*- Name represents each sector in the tooltip. This allows you to extract the name from the data: - `string`: the name of the field in the data object;
- `number`: the index of the field in the data;
- `function`: a function that receives the data object and returns the name.
 - DEFAULT: - `"name"`
- [reversed](https://recharts.github.io#reversed)boolean- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `false`
- [shape](https://recharts.github.io#shape)(union of 5 variants)- *optional*- If set a ReactElement, the shape of funnel can be customized. If set a function, the function will be called to render customized shape. During animations, the function shape also receives - `animationElapsedTime`,- `isAnimating`, and- `isEntrance`. By default, renders a trapezoid.
- [tooltipType](https://recharts.github.io#tooltipType)"none"- *optional*
- [onAbort](https://recharts.github.io#onAbort)AdaptChildReactEventHandler<P, T>- *optional*
- [onAbortCapture](https://recharts.github.io#onAbortCapture)AdaptChildReactEventHandler<P, T>- *optional*

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/FunnelChart/

### FunnelChart

#### Child Components

FunnelChart provides context for these components:

#### Props

- [accessibilityLayer](https://recharts.github.io#accessibilityLayer)boolean- *optional*- Turn on accessibility support for keyboard-only and screen reader users. - DEFAULT: - `true`
- [barCategoryGap](https://recharts.github.io#barCategoryGap)number | string- *optional*- The gap between two bar categories, which can be a percent value or a fixed value. - DEFAULT: - `"10%"`
- [barGap](https://recharts.github.io#barGap)number | string- *optional*- The gap between two bars in the same category. - DEFAULT: - `4`
- [barSize](https://recharts.github.io#barSize)number | string- *optional*- The width or height of each bar. If the barSize is not specified, the size of the bar will be calculated by the barCategoryGap, barGap and the quantity of bar groups.
- [baseValue](https://recharts.github.io#baseValue)"dataMax" | "dataMin" | number- *optional*- Configures the starting value used to build the internal baseline for non-ranged, non-stacked areas. - WARNING despite the name - `dataMin`|- `dataMax`this actually reads the domain instead, so it should rather be- `domainMin`|- `domainMax`. This looks like a small detail, but it's actually important because domains are usually extended automatically. For example the default numerical domain starts from 0.- `number`: uses the corresponding axis value as a flat baseline
- `dataMin`: uses the minimum of the value-axis domain
- `dataMax`: uses the maximum of the value-axis domain
 - This uses the same - `BaseValue`resolution as the- `baseValue`prop on- `<Area />`, but acts as a fallback: item-level- `Area.baseValue`takes precedence over the chart-level- `baseValue`.- Ignored for stacked areas and for ranged areas where - `dataKey`already returns- `[min, max]`tuples.- Note that the baseValue does not interact with - `animationInterpolateFn`; baseValue is always animated by linear interpolation. If you want a custom animation then have your- `dataKey`return a tuple of two values instead of a single number which will also render a ranged Area, and that does work with your custom- `animationInterpolateFn`.
- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*
- [className](https://recharts.github.io#className)string- *optional*
- [compact](https://recharts.github.io#compact)boolean- *optional*
- [cursor](https://recharts.github.io#cursor)(union of 45 variants)- *optional*- The CSS cursor style applied to the chart container. Useful for setting the mouse cursor when hovering over the chart (e.g. - `"pointer"`,- `"crosshair"`).
- [data](https://recharts.github.io#data)ReadonlyArray<DataPointType>- *optional*- The source data. Each element should be an object. The properties of each object represent the values of different data dimensions. - Use the - `dataKey`prop to specify which properties to use.- FORMAT: - `data={[{ name: 'a', value: 12 }]} data={[{ label: 'foo', measurements: [5, 12] }]}`
- [dataKey](https://recharts.github.io#dataKey)Function | number | string- *optional*
- [desc](https://recharts.github.io#desc)string- *optional*
- [height](https://recharts.github.io#height)`${number}%` | number- *optional*- The height of chart container. Can be a number or a percent string like "100%".
- [id](https://recharts.github.io#id)string- *optional*
- [layout](https://recharts.github.io#layout)"horizontal" | "vertical"- *optional*- The layout of chart defines the orientation of axes, graphical items, and tooltip. - DEFAULT: - `"horizontal"`
- [margin](https://recharts.github.io#margin)Partial<Margin>- *optional*- Empty space around the container. - DEFAULT: - `{"top":5,"right":5,"bottom":5,"left":5}`
- [maxBarSize](https://recharts.github.io#maxBarSize)number- *optional*- The maximum width of all the bars in a horizontal BarChart, or maximum height in a vertical BarChart.
- [ref](https://recharts.github.io#ref)Function | React.RefObject<SVGSVGElement> | null- *optional*
- [responsive](https://recharts.github.io#responsive)boolean- *optional*- If true, then it will listen to container size changes and adapt the SVG chart accordingly. If false, then it renders the chart at the specified width and height and will stay that way even if the container size changes. - This is similar to ResponsiveContainer but without the need for an extra wrapper component. The - `responsive`prop also uses standard CSS sizing rules, instead of custom resolution logic (like ResponsiveContainer does).- DEFAULT: - `false`
- [reverseStackOrder](https://recharts.github.io#reverseStackOrder)boolean- *optional*- If - `false`, stacked items will be rendered left to right. If- `true`, stacked items will be rendered right to left.- Render direction affects SVG layering, not x position. - DEFAULT: - `false`
- [role](https://recharts.github.io#role)string- *optional*- The ARIA role for the chart, which provides semantic information for screen reader users.
- [stackOffset](https://recharts.github.io#stackOffset)"expand" | "none" | "positive" | "sign" | "silhouette" | "wiggle"- *optional*- The type of offset function used to generate the lower and upper values in the series array. The types are built-in offsets in d3-shape. Only applicable for stacked Area or Bar charts. Has no effect when the stackId prop is not set on Area or Bar components. - DEFAULT: - `"none"`
- [style](https://recharts.github.io#style)React.CSSProperties- *optional*
- [syncId](https://recharts.github.io#syncId)number | string- *optional*- Charts with the same syncId will synchronize Tooltip and Brush events.
- [syncMethod](https://recharts.github.io#syncMethod)"index" | "value" | Function- *optional*- Customize how the charts will synchronize tooltips and brushes. - `index`: synchronize using the data index in the data array. Index expects that all data has the same length.- `value`: synchronize using the data value on categorical axis (categorical: XAxis in horizontal layout, YAxis in vertical layout). function: a custom sync method which receives tick and data as argument and returns an index.- DEFAULT: - `"index"`
- [tabIndex](https://recharts.github.io#tabIndex)number- *optional*- If and where the chart should appear in the tab order
- [throttleDelay](https://recharts.github.io#throttleDelay)"raf" | number- *optional*- Decides the time interval to throttle events. Only events defined in - `throttledEvents`prop are throttled. All other events are executed immediately/synchronously.- Options: - `number`: the time interval in milliseconds
- `'raf'`: use requestAnimationFrame to schedule updates.
 - DEFAULT: - `"raf"`
- [throttledEvents](https://recharts.github.io#throttledEvents)"all" | Array<keyof GlobalEventHandlersEventMap>- *optional*- Defines which events should be throttled. Events not in this list will not be throttled. - Use the special value - `'all'`to throttle all events. Empty array means no events are throttled.- Use the prop - `throttleDelay`to define the throttling interval.- If an event is on this list, then you lose the opportunity to access the event synchronously. Which means that if you want to call - `e.preventDefault()`or- `e.stopPropagation()`inside the event handler, then that event handler must not be in this list.- DEFAULT: - `["mousemove","touchmove","pointermove","scroll","wheel"]`
- [title](https://recharts.github.io#title)string- *optional*
- [width](https://recharts.github.io#width)`${number}%` | number- *optional*- The width of chart container. Can be a number or a percent string like "100%".
- [onClick](https://recharts.github.io#onClick)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of click in this chart.
- [onContextMenu](https://recharts.github.io#onContextMenu)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of contextmenu in this chart.
- [onDoubleClick](https://recharts.github.io#onDoubleClick)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of dblclick in this chart.
- [onMouseDown](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseDown)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mousedown in this chart.
- [onMouseEnter](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseEnter)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mouseenter in this chart.
- [onMouseLeave](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseLeave)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mouseleave in this chart.
- [onMouseMove](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseMove)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mousemove in this chart.
- [onMouseUp](https://recharts.github.io#onMouseUp)CategoricalChartFunc<React.MouseEvent<SVGGraphicsElement, MouseEvent>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of mouseup in this chart.
- [onTouchEnd](https://recharts.github.io#onTouchEnd)CategoricalChartFunc<React.TouchEvent<SVGGraphicsElement>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of touchend in this chart.
- [onTouchMove](https://recharts.github.io#onTouchMove)CategoricalChartFunc<React.TouchEvent<SVGGraphicsElement>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of touchmove in this chart.
- [onTouchStart](https://recharts.github.io#onTouchStart)CategoricalChartFunc<React.TouchEvent<SVGGraphicsElement>>- *optional*- The customized event handler of touchstart in this chart.

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/Label/

### Label

The "position" in view box of Cartesian Coordinates

The "position" in view box of PieChart

The "position" in view box of RadialBarChart

#### Parent Components

Label consumes context provided by these components:

#### Props

- [angle](https://recharts.github.io#angle)number- *optional*- Text rotation angle in degrees. Positive values rotate clockwise, negative values rotate counterclockwise. - DEFAULT: - `0`
- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*- The value of label can be set as children or as the - `value`prop- FORMAT: - `<Label>foo</Label>`
- [className](https://recharts.github.io#className)string- *optional*
- [content](https://recharts.github.io#content)Function | ReactNode- *optional*- If set a React element, the option is the custom react element of rendering label. If set a function, the function will be called to render label content. - FORMAT: - `<Label content={CustomizedLabel} /> const renderCustomLabel = (props) => <text {...props}>Custom Label</text>; <Label content={renderCustomLabel} />`
- [formatter](https://recharts.github.io#formatter)Function- *optional*- Function to customize how content is serialized before rendering. - This should return a renderable text - something that the - [Text](https://recharts.github.io/en-US/api/Text)component can render. Typically, a string or number. Custom components are not supported here - use the- `content`prop instead.
- [id](https://recharts.github.io#id)string- *optional*- Unique identifier of this component. Used as an HTML attribute - `id`.
- [index](https://recharts.github.io#index)number- *optional*
- [labelRef](https://recharts.github.io#labelRef)React.RefObject<SVGTextElement> | null- *optional*
- [offset](https://recharts.github.io#offset)number | string- *optional*- The offset to the specified "position". Direction of the offset depends on the position. - DEFAULT: - `5`
- [parentViewBox](https://recharts.github.io#parentViewBox)Required<CartesianViewBox> | Required<PolarViewBox>- *optional*
- [position](https://recharts.github.io#position)"bottom" | "center" | "centerBottom" | "centerTop" | "end" | "inside" | "insideBottom" | "insideBottomLeft" | "insideBottomRight" | "insideEnd" | "insideLeft" | "insideRight" | "insideStart" | "insideTop" | "insideTopLeft" | "insideTopRight" | "left" | "middle" | "outside" | "right" | "top" | { x?: string | number | undefined; y?: string | number | undefined; }- *optional*- The position of label relative to the view box. - DEFAULT: - `"middle"`
- [textBreakAll](https://recharts.github.io#textBreakAll)boolean- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `false`
- [value](https://recharts.github.io#value)false | null | number | string | true- *optional*- The value of label can be set as children or as the - `value`prop- FORMAT: - `<Label value="foo" />`
- [viewBox](https://recharts.github.io#viewBox)Required<CartesianViewBox> | Required<PolarViewBox>- *optional*- The box of viewing area. Used for positioning. If undefined, viewBox will be calculated based on surrounding context.
- [zIndex](https://recharts.github.io#zIndex)number- *optional*- Z-Index of this component and its children. The higher the value, the more on top it will be rendered. Components with higher zIndex will appear in front of components with lower zIndex. If undefined or 0, the content is rendered in the default layer without portals. - DEFAULT: - `2000`

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/LabelList/

### LabelList

#### Parent Components

LabelList consumes context provided by these components:

#### Props

- [angle](https://recharts.github.io#angle)number- *optional*- Text rotation angle in degrees. Positive values rotate clockwise, negative values rotate counterclockwise. - DEFAULT: - `0`
- [clockWise](https://recharts.github.io#clockWise)boolean- *optional*- The parameter to calculate the view box of label in radial charts.
- [content](https://recharts.github.io#content)Function | ReactNode- *optional*- If set a React element, the option is the customized React element of rendering each label. If set to a function, the function is called once for each item - FORMAT: - `<LabelList content={CustomizedLabel} />`
- [dataKey](https://recharts.github.io#dataKey)Function | number | string- *optional*- Decides how to extract the value of each label from the data: - `string`: the name of the field in the data object;
- `number`: the index of the field in the data;
- `function`: a function that receives the data object and returns the value of each label.
 - If set, then valueAccessor will be ignored. - Scatter requires this prop to be set. Other graphical components will show the same value as the dataKey of the component by default.
- [formatter](https://recharts.github.io#formatter)Function- *optional*- Function to customize how content is serialized before rendering. - This should return a renderable text - something that the - [Text](https://recharts.github.io/en-US/api/Text)component can render. Typically, a string or number. Custom components are not supported here - use the- `content`prop instead.
- [id](https://recharts.github.io#id)string- *optional*- Unique identifier of this component. Used as an HTML attribute - `id`.
- [offset](https://recharts.github.io#offset)number | string- *optional*- The offset to the specified "position". Direction of the offset depends on the position. - DEFAULT: - `5`
- [position](https://recharts.github.io#position)"bottom" | "center" | "centerBottom" | "centerTop" | "end" | "inside" | "insideBottom" | "insideBottomLeft" | "insideBottomRight" | "insideEnd" | "insideLeft" | "insideRight" | "insideStart" | "insideTop" | "insideTopLeft" | "insideTopRight" | "left" | "middle" | "outside" | "right" | "top" | { x?: string | number | undefined; y?: string | number | undefined; }- *optional*- The position of label relative to the view box. - DEFAULT: - `"middle"`
- [textBreakAll](https://recharts.github.io#textBreakAll)boolean- *optional*- DEFAULT: - `false`
- [valueAccessor](https://recharts.github.io#valueAccessor)Function- *optional*- The accessor function to get the value of each label. Is ignored if dataKey is specified.
- [zIndex](https://recharts.github.io#zIndex)number- *optional*- Z-Index of this component and its children. The higher the value, the more on top it will be rendered. Components with higher zIndex will appear in front of components with lower zIndex. If undefined or 0, the content is rendered in the default layer without portals. - DEFAULT: - `2000`

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/Layer/

### Layer

Creates an SVG group element to group other SVG elements. Useful if you want to apply transformations or styles to a set of elements without affecting other elements in the SVG.

# Recharts

Source: https://recharts.github.io/api/Legend/

### Legend

Tips: Hover the legend !

#### Props

- [align](https://recharts.github.io#align)"center" | "left" | "right"- *optional*- Horizontal alignment of the whole Legend container: - `left`: shows the Legend to the left of the chart, and chart width reduces automatically to make space for it.
- `right`shows the Legend to the right of the chart, and chart width reduces automatically.
- `center`shows the Legend in the middle of chart, and chart width remains unchanged.
 - The exact behavior changes depending on 'verticalAlign' prop. - DEFAULT: - `"center"`
- [children](https://recharts.github.io#children)ReactNode- *optional*
- [content](https://recharts.github.io#content)Function | ReactNode- *optional*- Renders the content of the legend. - This should return HTML elements, not SVG elements. - If not set, the [DefaultLegendContent](https://recharts.github.io/en-US/api/DefaultLegendContent)component is used.
- If set to a React element, this element will be cloned and extra props will be passed in.
- If set to a function, the function will be called and should return HTML elements.
 - FORMAT: - `<Legend content={CustomizedLegend} /> <Legend content={renderLegend} />`
- If not set, the
- [dangerouslySetInnerHTML](https://recharts.github.io#dangerouslySetInnerHTML)Object- *optional*
- [formatter](https://recharts.github.io#formatter)Formatter- *optional*- Function to customize how content is serialized before rendering. - This should return HTML elements, or strings. - FORMAT: - `(value, entry, index) => <span style={{ color: 'red' }}>{value}</span> https://codesandbox.io/s/legend-formatter-rmzp9`
- [height](https://recharts.github.io#height)number | string- *optional*- Height of the legend. Accept CSS style string values like - `100%`or- `fit-content`, or number values like- `400`.
- [iconSize](https://recharts.github.io#iconSize)number- *optional*- The size of icon in each legend item. - DEFAULT: - `14`
- [iconType](https://recharts.github.io#iconType)"circle" | "cross" | "diamond" | "line" | "none" | "plainline" | "rect" | "square" | "star" | "triangle" | "wye"- *optional*- The type of icon in each legend item.
- [inactiveColor](https://recharts.github.io#inactiveColor)string- *optional*- The color of the icon when the item is inactive. - DEFAULT: - `"#ccc"`
- [itemSorter](https://recharts.github.io#itemSorter)"dataKey" | "value" | Function | null- *optional*- Sorts Legend items. Defaults to - `value`which means it will sort alphabetically by the label.- If - `null`is provided then the payload is not sorted. Be aware that without sort, the order of items may change between renders!- DEFAULT: - `"value"`
- [labelStyle](https://recharts.github.io#labelStyle)React.CSSProperties- *optional*- The style of each text label which is a span element. - DEFAULT: - `{}`
- [layout](https://recharts.github.io#layout)"horizontal" | "vertical"- *optional*- The layout of legend items inside the legend container. - DEFAULT: - `"horizontal"`
- [payloadUniqBy](https://recharts.github.io#payloadUniqBy)UniqueFunc<LegendPayload> | false | true- *optional*
- [portal](https://recharts.github.io#portal)HTMLElement | null- *optional*- If portal is defined, then Legend will use this element as a target for rendering using React Portal. - If this is undefined then Legend renders inside the recharts-wrapper element.
- [verticalAlign](https://recharts.github.io#verticalAlign)"bottom" | "middle" | "top"- *optional*- The alignment of the whole Legend container: - `bottom`: shows the Legend below chart, and chart height reduces automatically to make space for it.
- `top`: shows the Legend above chart, and chart height reduces automatically.
- `middle`: shows the Legend in the middle of chart, covering other content, and chart height remains unchanged. The exact behavior changes depending on- `align`prop.
 - DEFAULT: - `"bottom"`
- [width](https://recharts.github.io#width)number | string- *optional*- Width of the legend. Accept CSS style string values like - `100%`or- `fit-content`, or number values like- `400`.
- [wrapperStyle](https://recharts.github.io#wrapperStyle)React.CSSProperties- *optional*- CSS styles to be applied to the wrapper - `div`element.
